signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a single-story house with a lawn, mulch beds and fence; the front facade and driveway are not clearly visible.

yard_sign.evidence: A small red and white sign is partly visible at the far left edge, but its wording can't be read and it may belong to a neighboring property.

professional_landscaping.evidence: The mulch beds are neat and the shrubs are trimmed, but there is no crew, equipment or truck, so this looks homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Corner-style lot with a wood privacy fence, a central AC unit on the side of the house and a light scatter of fallen leaves; a small red sign at the left edge is worth checking in person.
